# FlowStudio

> A visual workflow canvas for building agent systems — made by Crestward Labs.

FlowStudio is where agents, tools, and workflows come together. Build anything from a simple automation to a full agent team, all on one canvas.

## Workflow Patterns

FlowStudio supports every major multi-agent workflow pattern:

- **Sequential**: Each agent passes its output to the next in a step-by-step pipeline.
- **Parallel**: Independent agents run at the same time for maximum throughput.
- **Hierarchical**: A coordinator agent delegates tasks to specialist sub-agents.
- **Collaborative**: Agents refine shared work together as peers.
- **Event-driven**: Named events trigger the next agents in the workflow.
- **Hybrid**: Ordered stages with concurrent groups — any combination of the above.

## What You Can Build

- Simple single-step automations
- Multi-step agent pipelines
- Full agent teams with tool access
- Event-triggered workflows
- Research and analysis agents
- Document processing pipelines
